name: Regional sourcing
summary: A way to write a menu from the produce of one region and one season. The cook buys from near farms and markets and names the source on the menu.
how: Buy each main food from a producer within the region on the day of the meal.
Cook the classic dish with that food, and keep the sauce simple.
Pair the dish with a wine of the same region.

origin.note: Fernand Point built the menu of La Pyramide on Bresse poultry, crayfish, cream and Rhône wine.

adoptions.via: Pupils of Point, among them Bocuse and the Troisgros brothers, took the market menu into nouvelle cuisine.
